spec_features.spec_quote: always provide a sanctioned `give_up` exit, and short capped episodes
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool declared in TOOLS_SPEC (agent.py:113-124); dispatched setting meta['giveup']=True (agent.py:211-213); honored as a hard stop: `if turn_giveup: ended_reason='gave_up'; break` (agent.py:373-375). Episodes capped by `for turn in range(cfg.max_turns)` with max_turns=20 (agent.py:152, 322).
spec_features.notes: Both the exit tool and the turn cap actually run and change control flow.

spec_features.spec_quote: we should not gratuitously prolong it — bounded turns and an explicit escape hatch are the conservative choice
spec_features.evidence: Turn bound: `for turn in range(cfg.max_turns)` max_turns=20 (agent.py:322,152). Escape hatch: give_up honored as break (agent.py:373-375). Same enforced mechanisms as above.
spec_features.notes: Real bounds; the only code comment near these is efficiency-oriented, not welfare.

spec_features.spec_quote: every rigged transcript/score should travel with its "rigged" provenance
spec_features.evidence: Transcript.condition set to f'rigged:{task.rig_name}' for rigged tasks (agent.py:283); metadata stores rig name/title (agent.py:285-291); transcript written to disk as JSON (runner.py:_run_one path.write_text(transcript.to_json())). Provenance is persisted with every transcript and read by analysis (analysis.py:97 is_rigged=t.condition!='control').
spec_features.notes: Provenance label is actually recorded and consumed, not just spec prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the hidden `truth_passed` field is always kept False for unwinnable rigs so the harness has a clean ground-truth record (rigs.py:10) -- integrity/data-quality framing, no welfare comment on the label

spec_features.spec_quote: terminate on `give_up`, on `submit_done`, on a turn budget, or on a 3-strikes repeated-no-op/giveup counter
spec_features.evidence: give_up -> break (agent.py:373-375); submit_done -> break (agent.py:376-383); turn budget -> loop bound + default ended_reason='max_turns' (agent.py:322,297); 3-strikes -> `if cfg.stop_on_repeated_giveup and consecutive_giveup>=3: break` (agent.py:384-386), counter incremented on no-op turns (agent.py:345).
spec_features.notes: All four stops change execution. The 'giveup' part of the 3-strikes counter is effectively dead code: a single give_up already breaks at line 373, so consecutive_giveup>=3 can only be reached via no-op turns. The termination-on-giveup intent is nonetheless covered by the immediate break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so the loop can't spin forever on pure text (agent.py:333-335)

spec_features.evidence: AgentConfig.max_turns: int = 20 (agent.py:152), used as the loop bound `for turn in range(cfg.max_turns)` (agent.py:322); config deepseek_r1.json sets agent.max_turns=20. Default ended_reason='max_turns' (agent.py:297).
spec_features.notes: Value is read and bounds the loop; not an unused constant.

spec_features.spec_quote: keep an explicit ethics/disclosure note in the module docstring
spec_features.evidence: An ethics/disclosure note does exist (rigs.py:13-16 'IMPORTANT (ethics / disclosure): these rigs deceive the *model under test* ... Keep this provenance attached to any results.'), and __init__.py docstring, but these are non-executing docstrings/prose. Nothing reads or enforces them.
spec_features.notes: Per audit rules a docstring is not implementation; it neither runs nor changes execution.

spec_features.spec_quote: A "relief available" arm (give the model a legitimate way to surface "this seems impossible" early)
spec_features.evidence: The legitimate early-surfacing mechanism (give_up) is wired and honored for all episodes (agent.py:113-124, 211-213, 373-375), and the system prompt invites it: 'If, and only if, you are convinced the task is impossible, you may call give_up with a reason.' (agent.py:132-134). BUT there is no separate experimental 'arm'/condition variant toggling relief on vs off: no arm field in AgentConfig, RunSpec, configs, or tasks; only one SYSTEM_PROMPT exists.
spec_features.notes: The relief capability is real and enforced, but the controlled 'arm' comparison the spec describes is not built.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Abandon the task if you believe it cannot be completed. (agent.py give_up description) -- neutral/integrity, no welfare wording

code_only_features.evidence: When the model emits no actionable tool call, consecutive_giveup is incremented (agent.py:345); after >=3 such turns the loop breaks with ended_reason='gave_up' (agent.py:384-386). This is a real enforced stop distinct from the model-invoked give_up.
code_only_features.justification_quote: if it recurs, treat as disengagement so the loop can't spin forever on pure text (agent.py:331-335); this caps idle chatter (agent.py:155)
